evidence: Verified stage composition does not imply commutativity: filtering an authoritative deletion before version resolution can resurrect an older accepted state, while resolving first does not.
Verified equality-join fanout a_x*b_x and that a many-to-one claim requires at most one right occurrence under the library's declared key/missing relation.
Verified accepted/quarantined/excluded conservation applies only to occurrence-preserving classification and requires separate mappings for deduplication, explosion, and aggregation.
Verified peak memory is a maximum over simultaneously live buffers plus runtime state and cannot be inferred from source or output size alone.
